description: Post a comment on an opportunity, into the thread the Console shows. Use it to record a decision or an approval on the opportunity (not the `evidence` field, which is the case for the opportunity itself). Requires `write` scope and an editor-capable key owner; the comment is posted as the key owner.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

name: anyforge_post_opportunity_comment
title: Post opportunity comment
